run_aea_viewer: run the AEA viewer tool to visualize Aria Everyday Activities dataset recordings with ReRun
run_aea_viewer_with_undistort: run the AEA viewer with undistort flag to display undistorted pinhole camera model images
run_aea_viewer_save_rrd: run the AEA viewer and save the ReRun recording to an .rrd output file path
review_logStaticData: review the logStaticData function that logs point cloud, device trajectory, and camera calibration as static ReRun data
review_logInstanceData: review the logInstanceData function that logs per-timestamp images, eyegaze rays, and speech text overlays
